Students of Inha University in Tashkent took 1st place at National AI Hackathon 2026! 🏆

Following three days of intensive competition, the winners of National AI Hackathon 2026 in Tashkent have been announced. The event brought together 60 teams, challenging participants to develop innovative solutions using artificial intelligence.

In the Entrepreneurship Development track, the Centrum team from Inha University in Tashkent secured 1st place! 🥇
